::api-operation{method="GET" path="/v1/businesses/{biz}/test_limits"}
#docs
A create past the limit fails with code `test_business_limit_reached`. `limit` is null when there is no limit. Live businesses have no such limits.

## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | Business id (biz_…) |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | Always `test_limits`. One of `test_limits`. |
| `customers` | `object` | Customers. |
| `subscriptions` | `object` | Subscriptions. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | Success |
| `400` | Only available on test businesses |
| `404` | No such business |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/businesses/biz_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/test_limits" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY"
```
